title: command
description: An escape hatch: runs a program once, as root, without a shell (D-260). Key: name. It runs only while the path in creates does not exist; the program must create it. No drift: a changed argv on a guest where creates exists changes nothing. Every run is destructive (D-031): only a human session approves it, and an Image whose build Blocks hold a command is refused. Output is shown like every resource output (hidden when the resource has a secret). Kinds: vm, lxc.

argv.description: Program and arguments. The first entry is an absolute path. No shell: for one, write [/bin/sh, -c, "..."].

creates.description: Absolute path. When it exists, the command is done and does not run.

timeout.description: Seconds; the agent kills the program after this time and the step fails.
